mechanism: Albuterol (beta-2 agonist) antagonizes the beta-blocking effects of timolol, potentially reducing the therapeutic efficacy of timolol for glaucoma management and causing systemic cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor intraocular pressure closely and consider alternative bronchodilator (such as ipratropium) or alternative glaucoma medication; assess for reduced timolol efficacy and increased heart rate/blood pressure.
